Hi Liam — thanks for sending these quickly and for the clear notes. I pulled procurement and tax into the thread to speed validation. Next steps from our side:

1) Tax verification: our vendor team needs to confirm the EIN on the W-9 against IRS/third-party validation and reconcile the DBA vs legal name. Karthik, FYI — can you run ID verification and confirm whether the bank letter suffices or if we need a notarized affidavit?

2) Provisional PO: Procurement can issue a provisional PO for onboarding purposes, but we usually condition final payment on tax evidence clearing. Monica — can procurement provision PO-21087 as a "staged" PO (amount capped at $50k) pending KYC completion?

If you can confirm whether the invoices will reference the DBA or legal name, that will help us set payment instructions.
